title: Tractor & Field Words

expressions.expr: The tractor drives in a straight line
expressions.meaning: O trator anda em linha reta
expressions.example: With autosteer, the tractor drives in a straight line.

expressions.expr: The harvest season is very busy
expressions.meaning: A época de colheita é muito corrida
expressions.example: The harvest season is very busy for farmers.

expressions.expr: The farmer needs the machine today
expressions.meaning: O fazendeiro precisa da máquina hoje
expressions.example: The farmer needs the machine today. It is harvest time.

expressions.expr: There is dust on the monitor
expressions.example: There is dust on the monitor. Please clean it.

sentences: The tractor works in the field.
The farmer plants soybean in October.
Autosteer drives in a straight line.
The monitor is in the cab.
There is dust on the screen.

grammar.title: There is / There are: descrevendo o campo e a máquina
rules: There is + singular: There is a problem with the antenna.
There are + plural: There are two tractors on the farm.
Pergunta: Is there a signal here? / Are there new cables?
Muito útil para descrever o que você vê na máquina do cliente.
